decision.rationale: This official UBC Arts language-learning site describes courses jointly sponsored by UBC and the Kaska First Nations and makes materials available to students, community members and other learners. The homepage identifies Vancouver campus and a broad public learning purpose, not an exclusively Okanagan service. Map instructional sections to academics, narrative and community sections to stories, and contact to support.

rules.rationale: The homepage Contact section provides assistance accessing the language-learning project.
Homepage navigation explicitly identifies elders' commentaries, narratives, stories, conversations, books and a community hockey event as distinct sections.
Homepage photo scrapbooks and contributor profiles document people and community participation in the project.
The homepage lessons, sounds, instructional booklets and student assessment videos are course and language-learning materials.

fallback.rationale: The stated purpose is to house Kaska language course materials for UBC students, Kaska community members and other learners.
